column3: A new owner permission lets a plugin row run ops as the owner; automations declares it, and ops.run still refuses the owner actor for every row without it
column4: main's #23 automations start and continue threads as the owner, which #19's rule that a row acts only for an agent refused; acting as the owner is the point of an automation, so it becomes a declared, consented permission instead of a silent exception
